newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Repairs on Tanzania oil facilities nearly done.
newsitem.headline: Repairs on Tanzania oil facilities nearly done.

text.p: Repairs to Tanzania's sole offshore oil pumping facility, broken down for more than one month, will be completed on Monday, a port official said.
The Tanzania Harbour Authority official said off-loading of bulk fuel via the Single Point Mooring (SPM) should start on Tuesday.
"The high-pressure testing has been completed, everything seems to be fine now," the official, who declined to be named, told Reuters.
Tanzania receives its bulk fuel via the SPM. The entrance to Dar es Salaam harbour is too narrow and shallow to allow ocean going oil tankers to berth, according to maritime sources.
The completion of repairs would allow the Tanzanian-Italian petroleum refinery in Dar es Salaam to restart business after closing down two weeks ago due to the damaged pumping facility.
